description: A GTPE2_COMMON writes ENABLE_DRP when a channel of its quad drives DRPWE, its own DRP tied off
exercises: ENABLE_DRP of the GT COMMON in the FASM writer
a channel DRP in use next to a COMMON whose DRP is tied off
why: Vivado sets ENABLE_DRP of a GTPE2_COMMON or GTXE2_COMMON when a channel of the same quad drives DRPWE; the COMMON's own DRP, a channel DRPCLK alone and DRPEN alone leave it clear. Release 2026-10-15 writes it when the COMMON's own DRPCLK is connected: a quad whose channels use the DRP, with the COMMON's DRPCLK tied low, misses the bit, as the openPCIE x4 build of openXC7/nextpnr#88 does against its Vivado golden. The design assembles either way.
